schema.input: PIL.Image.Image, or a sequence of them for the validation stage; any mode, converted to RGB
schema.output: relative inverse depth, float32 H x W at the input resolution (larger = nearer)
schema.preprocessing: convert to RGB; the DPT processor rescales the sides to multiples of 14 near 518 px and the raw prediction is interpolated back (bicubic) to the input resolution
